exposure: Fetal Medicine Foundation 36-week model risk categories for subsequent preeclampsia
Fetal Medicine Foundation 36-week model risk categories for subsequent preeclampsia (A, ≥0.500; B, 0.20 to 0.499; C, 0.05 to 0.199; D, 0.020 to 0.049; and E, <0.020)
finding: Women in higher-risk strata for preeclampsia gave birth earlier, and more frequently following medically indicated delivery, compared with those in lower-risk strata.
mod_finding: This study did not examine the relationship between mode of delivery and the primary outcomes, although it did differentiate between spontaneous labor (irrespective of delivery mode) and medically indicated births.
